simpleresonance.guide.page.1.title: Simple Resonance
simpleresonance.guide.page.1: How experienced you are and how dangerous the land is:
simpleresonance.guide.page.2.title: Simple Resonance
simpleresonance.guide.page.2: your player value grows with playing time and bosses and falls only by a part when you die, danger zones rise softly with the distance from the world spawn, every monster spawn belongs to one player nearby, and a newcomer protection
simpleresonance.guide.page.3.title: Simple Resonance
simpleresonance.guide.page.3: keeps the first hours gentle. Other mods ask it through an API.
simpleresonance.guide.page.4.title: Player value
simpleresonance.guide.page.4: A number from 0 to 1 for how experienced a player is: W = 0.7 x long-term value + 0.3 x the share since the last death. Level P = 5 x W. It rises with active playing time and bosses and falls only by a part when you die.
simpleresonance.guide.page.5.title: Danger zones
simpleresonance.guide.page.5: The land gets more dangerous the farther it is from the world spawn:
simpleresonance.guide.page.6.title: Danger zones
simpleresonance.guide.page.6: level 0.5 up to 512 blocks, rising softly to 5 at 6000 blocks (smoothstep, no hard edges). The level only steers chances for status effects on new monsters.
simpleresonance.guide.page.7.title: Spawn owner and spawn level
simpleresonance.guide.page.7: Every monster spawn attempt belongs to exactly one player nearby, chosen with weight 1/distance (no average).
simpleresonance.guide.page.8.title: Spawn owner and spawn level
simpleresonance.guide.page.8: The spawn level is the zone level plus up to 2 levels for a strong owner, limited by the newcomer protection.
simpleresonance.guide.page.9.title: Newcomer protection
simpleresonance.guide.page.9: A spawn is at most one level above the level of its owner, and in the first 6 played hours monsters stay at level 1. Players standing within 40 blocks of the spawn limit it as well.
simpleresonance.guide.page.10.title: Interface for other mods
simpleresonance.guide.page.10: Other mods ask Simple Resonance through the framework contract ResonanceContracts (pure Java, no class import): player value, level, zone level, spawn owner, spawn level, award points, newcomer flag.
simpleresonance.guide.page.11.title: Interface for other mods
simpleresonance.guide.page.11: Without Simple Resonance the contract is empty and nothing changes.
simpleresonance.guide.page.12.title: Takeover from SimpleBuilding
simpleresonance.guide.page.13.title: Takeover from SimpleBuilding
simpleresonance.guide.page.13: on a player's first tick Simple Resonance reads the old tracker block SimpleBuildingData (baselines since the last death, active time, kill totals) and starts the long-term points at 1 per 30 old active minutes.
simpleresonance.guide.page.14.title: Takeover from SimpleBuilding
simpleresonance.guide.page.14: The base multiplier of the trim resonance is taken over from config/simplebuilding.json on the first start.
simpleresonance.guide.page.15.title: Commands
simpleresonance.guide.page.15: /resonance shows your value, the level of the land where you stand and your newcomer protection. /resonance debug (game masters) lists the possible owners of a spawn at your place with their chances.
simpleresonance.guide.page.16.title: Settings
simpleresonance.guide.page.16: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
quests.simpleresonance.start.title: Welcome to Simple Resonance
quests.simpleresonance.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simpleresonance.start.welcome.des: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Resonance Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and an echo shard.
